name: @openleash/desktop-client
description: Leash desktop agent policy and attention client.
author: Leash

scripts.dev: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node src/copy-assets.mjs && node src/build-native-island.mjs && node scripts/build-local-proxy.mjs
scripts.test: tsx --test src/availability-circuit.test.ts src/availability-local-server.test.ts src/local-server-auth.test.ts src/proxy-manager.test.ts src/agent-registry.test.ts src/activity-island.test.ts src/background-control.test.ts src/agent-session-focus.test.ts src/agent-restart.test.ts src/notice-window.test.ts src/intent-dedupe.test.ts src/notice-presentation.test.ts src/notification-baseline.test.ts src/event-decision-controls.test.ts src/install-state.test.ts src/startup-visibility.test.ts src/protection-install-lifecycle.test.ts src/local-server-token.test.ts src/setup-connection-draft.test.ts src/setup-install-progress.test.ts src/setup-island-choice.test.ts src/setup-audience-flow.test.ts src/feature-presentation.test.ts src/plugin-detail-edit-refresh.test.ts src/plugin-install-state.test.ts src/session-monitoring.test.ts src/project-exclusions.test.ts src/instruction-rules.test.ts src/policy-defaults.test.ts src/docker-executable.test.ts
